rationale: 10 of 11 prior blocking findings resolved by source-verified changes; CR-008 remains unresolved — GlobalExceptionHandlerTest.java was not modified in the fix-up, the @WebMvcTest/@Import double-registration pattern is unchanged, and the fix evidence provides a verbal investigation argument that cannot be confirmed by source inspection alone.

business_review.item: ApiResponse<T> has a single `data` field only — no timestamp, status code, or message
